note: New knowledge pack (ticket #809, frontend wave 5). Fences: make-component owns the build PROCEDURE (tier/anatomy/API/geometry/taste-gate) — n01-n03 fence it, this pack answers platform facts a builder consults alongside that procedure, never a substitute. reactivity-facts owns the reactivity KERNEL (signal/computed/effect/scope) that decides WHEN a re-stamp fires — n04-n06 fence it; this pack owns stamping STRATEGY/mechanism (which of the three, keyed reconcile, the display:contents trap). n07-n08 fence ui-pattern-facts and data-wiring-facts (unrelated domains). n09-n10 are unrelated-domain no-trigger cases.
